captures.note: User-supplied captures of the current game, re-rendered with the shipped forward model and outline rule up to one whole-shape translation. Not independent holdouts.

crossTool.note: Same length/thickness/gap/height as crosshair.club exports under the shipped model. Software agreement, not game captures.

scope.note: Evaluated design: equal old, current and screen heights at the pixel goal, plus the listed old/current/screen-height scopes at either goal. The rate is not claimed outside it.

mlCrossCheck.note: Whole-export agreement (length, thickness, gap, outline mode and alpha, colour, fill alpha, T) of the export-state learner v2 with the converter on a reserved synthetic set, scored after training. The partition named fresh was evaluated in earlier releases and is reused regression evidence for community-static-v11, not fresh independent validation. Interval is a group-resampling stability interval. Its inference never runs the solver. Agreement with our own method, not game accuracy.

interpretation: Every target in this corpus study is a source-derived legacy prediction. Cross-validation and bootstrap describe that benchmark, not undisclosed new-client rendering.
